name: DC battle resurrection: no charge limit in the open world, Rebirth still resurrects
description: DC/DungeonQoL limits combat resurrections only in active Mythic+ runs and the raids in DC.BattleRes.RaidMaps. This is the negative control for that limit: outside them the charge metric reports no limit and Rebirth works as stock. A refusal test needs a listed raid with an encounter in progress (follow-up).

steps.label: Rebirth rank 7 (triggered: no reagent, no cast time)
The victim gets a resurrection request
